import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def reqf(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t", to="sip:bob@lab.test", cid="demo",
         cseq="7 MESSAGE", cl="0", extra=None, body=b"", method="MESSAGE",
         uri="sip:bob@lab.test"):
    hs = []
    if frm is not None: hs.append(("From", frm))
    if to is not None: hs.append(("To", to))
    if cid is not None: hs.append(("Call-ID", cid))
    if cseq is not None: hs.append(("CSeq", cseq))
    if cl is not None: hs.append(("Content-Length", cl))
    if extra:
        hs.extend(extra if isinstance(extra, list) else [extra])
    return mkreq(method=method, uri=uri, headers=hs, body=body)

def reason_of(wire, **kw):
    rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", h(wire))]))
    if rc != 0: return ("EXIT", rc)
    r = json.loads(out)
    return r["results"][0].get("reason", r["results"][0]["decision"])

def ck(name, wire, want, **kw):
    got = reason_of(wire, **kw)
    expect(name, got == want, f"want={want} got={got}")

def res_of(wire, **kw):
    rc, out, err = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", h(wire))]))
    assert rc == 0, (rc, err)
    return json.loads(out)["results"][0]

# ---- To
ck("to mismatch", reqf(to="sip:other@lab.test"), "fields")
